contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Created the game design and original Lantern Reach setting; directed the production of Jump-1.

contributions.name: Nilo / Codex
contributions.summary: Implemented the engine, interface, audio and integrations under Cédric Bernadac’s direction. Refreshed crew, port, commerce and journal layouts in 0.2.0; refined native Blender faces and integrated the canonical ship. Added destination briefings, departure confirmation, scene guidance and action reports in 0.3.0, preserving deterministic rules and saves.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1
contributions.summary: Created original Blender models, materials and image renders, including the native HD ship cutaway, under Cédric Bernadac's direction. Refined the 16 crew portraits and four inhabited port/bar scenes for the 0.2.0 visual refresh.

contributions.name: Claude Opus 5.5
contributions.summary: Added the first-voyage guide, the crew and port explanations, and the draggable star chart in 0.1.2, under Cédric Bernadac's direction.
